work.abstract_text: Extending Bala's divisibility results (Bala, 2026), we prove his conjecture in OEIS A295462, References (%D), record #19; contribution dated 23 August 2026: the integer a(n)=(15n)!(2n)!/((10n)!(6n)!n!) is odd exactly when consecutive one-bits of n have at least three zero-bits between them. A nonnegative floor function expresses its prime valuations. We reprove Bala's two divisibilities (Bala, 2026) and deduce product divisibility by (6n+1)(10n+1), preservation of the parity criterion, and counting and ordered recursions. We give written alternative proofs of the eleven XOR identities in A048718, verified by Karlsson (2022) with Walnut. For T(n)=(12n)!n!/((6n)!(4n)!(3n)!), we prove the five fixed divisibilities and both product families posed in A295431 on 28 August 2025, with C(k,R)=36(R-1)!lcm(1,...,12R) for k=1,2,3 and D(R)=(R-1)!lcm(1,...,R).

work.title: Parity and product extensions of Bala's divisibilities (2026): OEIS A295462, References (record #19; contribution dated 23 August 2026)
